description: This file defines the internal sealed class 'CallbackData' which manages callback handling, including timeout, cancellation, and failure scenarios for message responses within the Orleans runtime system.

classes.name: CallbackData
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of callback responses, including response handling, cancellation, timeout, and failure detection within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: SubscribeForCancellation
methods.description: Registers a cancellation callback to handle external cancellation requests.

methods.name: OnStatusUpdate
methods.description: Updates the last known status for the callback.

methods.name: IsExpired
methods.description: Checks if the callback has expired based on the current timestamp.

methods.name: OnTimeout
methods.description: Handles timeout scenarios for the callback.

methods.name: OnTargetSiloFail
methods.description: Handles failure of the target silo.

methods.name: DoCallback
methods.description: Invokes the response callback when a response is received.
